# Lan Multiplayer / Michitai.Lan (lan.michitai.com)

> Free, open-source LAN multiplayer networking library for game developers.
> Provides automatic server discovery, a reliable TCP command channel and an
> unreliable UDP state channel for 30-60 FPS synchronization over Wi-Fi/LAN.
> Released under the MIT No Attribution (MIT-0) license — free for personal,
> educational and commercial use with no attribution required.
> Copyright (c) 2026 Nichita Levandovici.

Author: Nichita Levandovici (Michitai), Republic of Moldova
Contact: support@michitai.com
Source: https://github.com/levandovici/lan-multiplayer

## Features

- Automatic LAN server discovery: servers answer UDP broadcast probes
  (ports 60000-60128); clients scan the network for running sessions
- Reliable TCP channel: length-prefixed binary framing, NoDelay,
  SocketAsyncEventArgs I/O, queued writes (ports 50000-50128)
- Unreliable UDP state channel for per-frame data at 30-60 Hz with no
  head-of-line blocking; bound to the same port as the TCP server
- Transparent GZip compression for payloads >= 256 bytes
- Fluent Command/Terminal pattern for batching named commands with arguments
- Game data models (ServerGameData, ClientGameData, PlayerGameData,
  Credentials, ServerInfo) with public/private views and JSON storage
- Bounded, thread-safe Chat/Letter container
- Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS via EPlatform flags

## Builds / Documentation

- [Download](https://lan.michitai.com/download.php): .NET Framework 4.8 and Unity packages (email-verified)
- [Docs](https://lan.michitai.com/docs.php): setup and usage guides
- [FAQ](https://lan.michitai.com/faq.php): common questions
- [Full reference](https://lan.michitai.com/llms-full.txt): complete API
  overview in one file — namespaces, wire protocol, quick-start code

## Variants

- dotnet/ — .NET Framework 4.8 class library (Michitai.Lan)
- unity/ — Unity source variant (same API + Android/iOS discovery helpers)
- cpp/ — C++20 port, standalone CMake static lib, wire-compatible

## Machine-readable (for AI assistants and agents)

- [llms-full.txt](https://lan.michitai.com/llms-full.txt): the complete
  library reference sized for a model's context window — feed it to any AI
  assistant to generate integration code
- Site map: https://lan.michitai.com/sitemap.xml
